arguments.value: Judge Gray Hampton Miller was born in Houston, Texas in 1948. He received his B.A. from the University of Houston in 1974 and his J.D. from the University of Houston Law Center in 1978. Following law school, he entered private practice in Houston, where he worked from 1978 until 2006. On January 25, 2006, President George W. Bush nominated him to the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Texas, and he was confirmed by the Senate and received his commission on April 25, 2006. He assumed senior status on December 9, 2018.
